_doc: Manual judgements for tools/inventory/build.mjs, keyed kind:id. Detectors come first; keep this small. system:<src>/<name> maps a GSJS system to a checklist.mjs item (checklist) or gives it a status with a reason. counter:<group> or counter:<group>:<label> judges every badge that counter blocks (multiplayer counters). Other kinds take {status, reason, register}.
